subject.title: Discord turns can be missed or finish silently across gateway restart/recovery on 2026.6.10

question: Which owner boundary should drive the next fix for this multi-surface Discord restart failure: provider-history catch-up, durable delivery reconciliation, cron/task recovery, or a coordinated restart reliability plan?
rationale: The source evidence confirms real gaps, but safe replay and catch-up semantics affect duplicate-send risk, channel/plugin API contracts, persisted recovery state, and upgrade behavior.
